title: Projektetage Uniform Morph Typography
description: Make projektetage intro title a bit smaller. Ensure all presentation morph element kinds (title, description, goal, authors, affiliations) use the same default text size across all slides.
summary:
Split intro morph typography into title and secondary tiers.

- Title (`data-id` participant `title`): `--r-presentation-morph-title-size` 1.35em via `presentation-morph-text--title`.
- Description and goal (and authors/affiliations): `--r-presentation-morph-secondary-size` 1.15em via `presentation-morph-text--secondary`.
- Size class derives from reveal `morphId` (participant id) in the renderer.
- Test asserts title leaves use `--title`, description/goal use `--secondary`.
- All presentation renderer tests pass.
